newsitem.title: USA: Iowa Grain Inc dismissed from HTA lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: Iowa Grain Inc dismissed from HTA lawsuit.

text.p: Attorneys for Iowa Grain Co and the plaintiffs in a lawsuit stemming from a hedge-to-arrive contract said Iowa Grain Co was dismissed from the lawsuit.

Nicholas Iavarone, attorney for the plaintiffs Lowell and Doretta Harter, said Iowa Grain was dismissed from the lawsuit Thursday at the suggestion of the U.S. District Court judge. The plaintiffs were continuing their case against Andersons Inc and Anderson Investment Services.

Iavarone said the Harters in 1995 entered into a hedge-to-arrive contract with the Andersons and filed the suit May 16, 1996, to void that contract. If the contract is fulfilled the Harters would stand to lose about $60,000, Iavarone said.
Iowa Grain Co is a Chicago-based futures commission merchant. Andersons Inc is an Ohio-based grain merchandising company.
